method: Opened all80 exported sheets and all12 readable details using view_image; compared each paired actual final-source rendering with preserved BEFORE frames, using canonical origin decisions and grayscale main-only organization as supporting diagnosis. Route-specific judgments below are independent of peer first20 review. No browser recapture or test reclassification.

baselineDashboardInitialization.interpretation: All8 analytics and all8 operations baseline frames show explicit unavailable-control fallback and em-dash metrics with empty captureErrors arrays. Final frames are initialized. This is not matched hydration timing; no new fixture-data or functional-regression inference is made from this screenshot difference. Technical data/controller parity is independent.

limits: This is a bounded visual composition review of actual final-source captures, not universal source identity, usability certification, or manual assistive-technology testing.

All80 contacts were opened and inspected: all50 paired routes at1440px/320px in light/dark mode, normal primary and strict main-only diagnostic. Normal contacts show the first1000px; strict clips are main-only and bounded. Twelve larger detail comparisons supplement selected archetypes. Full-resolution originals remain authoritative outside the portable book.

The older analytics and operations captures contain literal unavailable-control fallback and em-dash metrics in all16 paired baseline states. Final frames show initialized values. They are not perfectly matched initialization/hydration states; screenshots do not establish when initialization completed or that fixture data was added by reconciliation. The unchanged data/controller contract is supported by independent technical receipts.

Horizontal overflow inside named tables/code regions is intentional for genuinely two-dimensional content. Contact sheets show the left viewport only; keyboard scrolling, right-edge access, region names, and complete-file/data checks are separate technical evidence.

Dark full-page treatments and unobserved application compositions remain contextual or experimental extensions. Canonical light-mode origin observations and supporting React catalogs are precedents, not certification of every Jekyll archetype.

The18 recipe-local changed routes include retained semantic anatomy with measured CSS or accessible-name refinements. The other32 retain recipe anatomy/style; both families also include separately recorded shared-header200% repairs. Retain does not mean globally byte-identical.

Both200%header details use exact accepted reading-source BEFORE pins whose host stylesheet is byte-identical to the earlier all50 baseline, explicitly separate from that baseline source commit. Actual final AFTER captures preserve native/artifact bindings.

Static forms, account flows, chat, sensors, fleet, and scene demonstrations remain local or synthetic specimens. These images do not verify live auth, persistence, delivery, devices, commerce, or server-error status.
